simple.meaning: לֶהָבָה (lehâbâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “flame(-ming), head (of a spear).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

occurrences.englishText: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon,

The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron.‡ A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 600 shekels is about 6 kilograms or about 13 pounds. His shield bearer went before him.
Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
so pursue them with your tempest,
He gave them hail for rain,
A fire was kindled in their company.
Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble,
The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you,
“Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon;
He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger.
Tell the land of Israel, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
“Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.
For they have prepared their heart like an oven,

The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them, and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, Yahweh has spoken.
